comment: Pin the .NET SDK so the build never silently uses an older toolchain that bundles the vulnerable NativeAOT compiler (Microsoft.DotNet.ILCompiler < 10.0.14, GHSA-p3jp-9v83-76w9 / CVE-2026-111497). SDK 10.0.404 is the first 10.0.4xx band that ships ILCompiler 10.0.15. rollForward=latestFeature lets newer SDKs (10.0.5xx+) be used but refuses to fall back to 10.0.402 and earlier. Update the version when you move to a newer SDK band.
